purpose: Semantic placement audit for fighting animations. This is a routing manifest, not a claim that every clip is visually certified.

routing_rules.down_punch_or_kick: 2/3/1 commands must route to crouching_strike unless an explicit authored command has a stronger measured match
routing_rules.up_punch: 8/9+P routes to airborne_jump_punch or uppercut_rising according to stance
routing_rules.spin: spinning/rotating clips are not rejected merely because facing temporarily turns away; the impact-frame facing and limb reach remain authoritative
routing_rules.grapple: grapple initiators and receiver clips remain paired; never substitute a strike animation for a grapple
routing_rules.reaction: receiver/reaction clips never enter the attacker strike pool

verification.note: Static measurements establish routing candidates; browser playtest must certify visible contact, timing, floor behavior, and recovery.
